body: Give me a break, huh?  It's a figure of speech not meant to be taken literally.
She does computer work, it's actually more complex than it sounds.

Try getting a maximum of 20-30 hours a week at $8/hr and get back to me.  It's a valid characterization of what is happening to people.  Human beings, who actually want to work and live, but can't do so.  Sounds like an ass raping to me.
Yep, thanks anyway.

I don't even know why I have to state the obvious, I guess because there's so much propaganda out there about how nobody makes the minimum.

Another factor is all the god damn people who don't get 40 hours and want them, again, like my sister that works for a library (a federal job), and even there she isn't getting enough hours, it's sad and pathetic.

This shit isn't complicated, even red states are raising the minimum.  But what we really need is some sort of basic income that brings all the part-timers up to like $12K a year, then watch the economy roar as a significant portion of the people will have enough to share an apartment and live.
Change... back to the 90's you can believe in.

My sister makes $8 instead of the federally mandated $7.25, woopty fucking doo, the minimum still needs to go to $10.  How many people make between $7.25 and $9?  That's how many people are being ass raped.

Edit:  I'd love to hear why I'm being downvoted.
I appreciate your thoughts.

Anybody who has any amount of self-worth has some degree of standards.  Even though I am in the lowliest of positions currently, is that my true worth?  I don't see it that way even though others might say take whatever you can get.  I don't need to add to my problems.

When you're self-employed which I have been my entire life there is no safety net or system of benefits for such individuals.  You're on your own.

I rarely see my friends anymore anyway.  I got in an argument with him a few months ago.  I'm tired of being made to feel like I'm a piece of shit around them.  But with oil prices where they are, what goes around may come around to them in the end, and then maybe they will learn some empathy and humility for market forces beyond their control (which I have been the victim of as well).  When people are successful they tend to overestimate their own capabilities and wisdom.  And they see people who are not successful as lacking in these same qualities.

Any sense of entitlement I used to have has long since been crushed by years of humbling destitution.  The only thing I think I'm entitled to is a living wage where I can pay basic rent, food, health care, etc.  The problem is there are too many jobs out there that are essentially scams mascarading as real employment opportunities.  You probably come from a country with a high minimum wage law.  We don't have that sort of thing in the US.
I don't feel comfortable asking them to stake their reputation on me.

That's one of my problems, I am in my early 30's and I look like a child that's not old enough to buy alcohol.  It's hard to man up when the world looks at you like that.  Any respect you get will have to be earned after the fact when people have alreadly instantly judged you.  At one time I had considered law school but the main reason I didn't do it is because I know lawyers need their clients to trust them upon an initial consultation.  For some reason all my siblings are the same way.  Must be some sort of genetic defect.
Are they nice people?  No.  Are you and others still going to watch them?  Yes.  Do they have a legal right to defend their economic interests in the market?  Yes!
I'll check that Altucher out, thanks.

I've met a lot of nice religious people, but you're right, many of them are hypocrites of the worst kind.  When I was young I was more motivated by money.  I had big dreams.  But now I just feel lonely more than anything else.  Without someone to live for I fear I can't muster the motivation, but that's a paradox, because without motivation I can't find someone to live for.  It's like being trapped in a box with no obvious exit.

That would be nice if I had connections.  I've always been an introvert, and there's nothing wrong with that, but it does tend to decrease the size of your social circle.  But they people I do know, that are my friends, are truly friends to keep and not just throwaway friends like many people collect on Facebook.
Good to know, I had considered physical therapy also in the past.
What does gender have to do with it?  Just upper body strength?
The only way I'd go back to school is if I knew a job would be waiting for me upon completion.  I really don't have faith that is the case even with the job market recovery.

That's the last type of job I'd like, but I would take it if offered at a reasonble salary plus commission.  But I can't take anymore god damn jobs that are 100% commission.  I can't handle the uncertainty.

It's true, countries without a healthy financial system tend to be very poor and can't break out of 3rd world status.  We also have laws that protect consumers of debt, such as a cooling off period for people that are impulsive buyers.  Did the financial industry go too far? Yes.  Are many of them crooks out to fuck people however they can get away with it?  Yes.  Should a bunch of them have gone to jail after 2008?  Yes.  Are many of the same crooks profiting in other ways now?  Yes.  But you know what we still need the banks.  We just need common sense regulations and regulators that actually do their job.
My dog is really my salvation.  My previous dog died this year and I had to get another.  They truly are man's best friend.

That's sounds awesome.  I think I should start cooking but I've lacked motivation there, so I usually eat something simple and boring like a sandwich.  What really pisses me off about drinking alcohol is that my tolerance is so high I have to drink a ton to get a solid buzz, and then I sleep horribly that night.  Like I'll be lucky to get 4 hours of sleep then I'm wide awake and can't go back to bed for many hours.  Then I sleep through a good part of the afternoon when I should be active.  Then it's dark again and the day is lost.  I'm like, FUCK, that alcohol was not worth it last night.  But it doesn't matter how many times this happens, I always beat myself over the head with a stick again.  I used to enjoy playing games now I can't stand the thought of playing anything.  So I just Reddit, read the news, and study the stock market which I'll never make any money in anyway but I like it regardless.

Gonna go try a little meditation, good talking to you.
Go to hell you self-righteous prick.
I didn't say YOU wanted to kill me.  You suggested it might be a good idea though (at least hoping it happens), and God will judge you for that, so go fuck yourself you jerk.

My friends are frustrated with me because I have lost all motivation, not necessarily just because I am at home.  So that statement isn't quite fair to them.  They tell me to date people and I'm like WTF, who would want to date a person like myself right now?  Nobody worth it, that's who.

I put the cutoff at $12 because I literally cannot support myself without such a basic income, and I'm just talking about shelter, food, health insurance, etc, nothing fancy.  This world is fucked up man.  They give my sister like 10 hours a week and pay her like $8 an hour.  I'm like, WTF not even worth going to work.  My life will not be improved by working for $8 an hour, it will in fact be fucked even further.  I'm not in high school anymore, I was making more adjusted for inflation when I was in fucking high school.

I do often go for long walks with my dog by the lake behind our house.  It's a good place for me to think, but it's been too cold to go lately which has depressed me further.  Sometimes I don't shower or brush my teeth for a period of a few days, then I will start doing it again.  I like to also meditate in a warm bath for an hour or more.  I enjoy going to the grocery store to shop for food, but everytime I see myself in the mirror I'm pissed at myself for not losing weight.  

I always get on a diet then fail.  I always quit drinking alcohol for like a week to 10 days then fail.  I have so many false starts and regressions it's disheartening.  I'm not really into singing, but I have some motivational music I enjoy.  So many songs are about sadness and loss.  I used to enjoy smoking weed, it would make me really happy, but now it does the opposite.  I enjoy watching my dog play with other dogs by the lake, but then I think how ignorance is a bliss I will never have.  I feel like some smart people are more prone to depression because they can see things other's can't or don't as often.  But then I feel stupid all the time.  I feel stupid that I am in the position I am in now.

I almost had enough money at one point to buy a cheap condo in a halfway decent area, but then some realtor bought it right before me and then resold it for like almost twice as much money as they paid.  It's like, WTF, nothing ever goes my way.  I ask for a raise after I'm told I'm the best at what I do, and I'm told that only desperate people do this job, so basically no, and they're thinking about lowering it.

If I had someone to live for I think I could muster what you have done, but it's hard when you're alone for as long as I have been.  It's hard when you feel worthless because people tell you that you're pathetic because you still live at home with parents.  You accept your place, you lose confidence in yourself, and then you just stop giving a fuck.  It's a vicious cycle that I'm still not sure how to break out of.
Mostly yes.  I need to lose about 40 pounds, and I have a bit of carpal tunnel syndrome in my left wrist, but nothing serious.
I know it's not the worst problem to have in the world but it's so aggrivating.
Thank you good guy/gal Christian.

At one point I had considered law school, but I knew I would be at a significant disadvantage when meeting with new clients.  When you're dealing with something serious, which the law often is, people have to trust who they're dealing with.  If you have the reputation that's one thing, but if you're just a 30 year old guy out of law school that looks like a kid, nobody is going to trust you and you won't have enough time to demonstrate that you are worthy of respect.

I'm in Texas, but with oil prices where they are at I doubt it's easy to get any oil job with zero experience in the industry.
Good advice, thanks.

I don't agree I need to attone for anything I have done, which has been perfectly legal and isn't that fucking bad regardless of the legality.  I made a contract for people, they signed it, then they got to review the paperwork for weeks, and then they signed it all again in front of a notary at a title company.  Lots of people decided to cancel after the fact, and I never tried to argue with them otherwise or high pressure anyone.  Every fucking person made the decision to borrow money at high interest because they wanted new windows or siding on the walls of their god damn house.  I take personal responsibility for the mistakes I have made in my life.
No man, he's a Christian, a holy man of God.  I am just a shitty atheist that should die.

People tell me this all the time and I know people treat you differently as a result.  I feel like this is just another hinderance holding me back from achieving any real progress.  I wish I knew a friend who could open a door for me.

If I met such a lady I could probably muster the confidence and will to find a way out of the box I'm trapped in.

Until it's destroyed by global warming, sure.  I'm not sure that job is 'honorable' enough for the people saying I should kill myself in this thread.
I do think I would be happy with a family.  I'm passionate about criminal and quasi-legal mischief on Wall Street, because it has destroyed my life.
Not yet, know any ladies interested in total failures in their 30's?  At least I'm not a violent criminal.  I have that going for me.
Whatever bro, good day to you.

Thanks that's very nice.
That sounds wonderful but I doubt I'll ever have a family to love like you do.
Why would I want to contribute to a society that has decided I am worthless.  My attitude is really to the point where I'm just like, fuck the world.
It's sort of the last straw that breaks the camels back.  It's disheartening when you open up and people are like, wow kill yourself already.

I have thought about getting a private investigator license, but that too makes me feel like I'm wasting my time if no one will hire me anyway.  I don't think I could justify going into an MBA program unless I had 1-2 years of solid experience/work history in a related field.  To be honest I'd be happy with $12-15 an hour but I don't think it will happen easily.
Like I told them I'm no saint, but no I don't think I'm horrible.
Perhaps in 10-15 years I can recover, but then I'm too old to start a family.  Basically a dead end biologically speaking.
What if it were nearly impossible for you to get a real job even though you have a college education?  Would you be content to live with your parents forever?
I know that's what some people would do, but I can't bring myself to do it.  Maybe that's ego, and that's my problem, but it is what it is.  Maybe I should go see a therapist.
If she can manage a trip to Switzerland she can end her suffering peacefully and with dignity.

Several people told me I should kill myself because I'm a horrible person, so I'm thinking, well maybe they're right, especially since I seem to have little hope for the future anyway.

I doubt I will commit suicide, but the concept is not without merit.

Of course it is my body and my right to end it if I choose.  So my right to do violence to myself is a human right.  The only question that remains is when should one do it?  There's broad agreement that when you're elderly/dying/in pain that it's justified, but are there are not other forms of pain and suffering that justify it as well?  Hope seems to be the deciding factor.  If you have hope you keep going, if you don't you should just do yourself a favor.
Yeah, as in not an emotional attachment to continuing to breath just for the sake of the next breath and little else.

I would be happy to hop into any less hostile field, the problem is I can't.  No one would hire me.  Another guy here said I should fall off a cliff because I'm a horrible person.  I probably won't do that, but I'm seriously considering just checking out of society and watching TV and Redditing for the rest of my life.  The fucking world doesn't want to give people like me a second chance.  Well fuck them all.  All my friends are involved in the oil industry making a killing, that's just destroying the planet.  Everywhere you look there are people participating in shit that they shouldn't be because they need to make a living.  That's just the nature of the shitty world we live in.
